name: Maven Central Search API
tagline: Search and resolve Maven packages from Central Repository
description: The Maven Central Search API provides programmatic access to search, resolve, and retrieve metadata for artifacts published to Maven Central Repository. Developers can query by groupId, artifactId, version, class names, and other coordinates to discover packages and dependencies.

auth.details: No authentication required for public search endpoints

use_cases: search Maven artifacts by groupId and artifactId
find latest version of a Java library
lookup package coordinates for a dependency
discover artifacts by class name or checksum
